nom: Murad Vitamin C Dark Circle Correcting Eye Serum

avis.texte: I noticed a significant difference after using the product consistently for 2 weeks there were no dark circles under my eyes.
This serum works wonders on dark underwear circles. You see results within two weeks. I'm a fan for life
I've tried inexpensive drugstore creams and higher priced. I had high hope for this, but it did absolutely nothing to get rid of my circles.
This product is fantastic. The dark under eye circles are beginning to lighten. I will definitely be buying this again

avis.titre: I COULDNT TELL IF IT WORKED
avis.texte: I am a black woman with dark circles under my eyes and I couldnt tell after about a year of using this if it worked or not. I think it should be clear that the darkness and aging under the eyes is going away after that long. there were also problems with the pump. i ordered this about 3 different times over the course of that time from a different makeup store and from here if im not mistaken and sometimes the bottle would come empty and nothin gwould come out of a brand new container. there was no way to tell when the bottle was getting low and until you were just out so you couldnt tell when it was time to buy a new bottle to have one on the way. the design was a bit weird to be able to tell how much product you had left. i liked how it felt and looked with the gold glimmer but the dark circles are darker than my skin and not a good look. i dont have time to play around wiht these creams that arent going to work for real people
I've used this for a couple of years and it seems to camouflage my dark circles under my eyes. I put it on before my foundation. You only need a tiny bit.

My whole life i have had dark circles underneath my eye. This product helped resolve that problem. I make sure to put it on eveey moring snd occisonally feel confident enough to go out the house with out having to put on any type of concealer or make up
I wanted this to work, but when I used it around my eyes it burned..
This product really works to correct those dark under-eyes. if it didn't smells so bad, I'd give it 5 stars
I had high hopes because of the reviews but I hate using this. the smell is strong and reminds me of barbecue sauce!

Wish it came in travel size only because of initial costs.I purchased the full size previously. But all used up! lol 71yrs old.My younger sister told me I looked so pretty one day.And all I had done different was put on Murad environmental Vita-C eyes dark circle corrector.Then I started seeing results after a couple weeks.

I am only 26 years of age and its working drastically and at a fast pace!I know it's supposed to be a two weeks change but its helping within just days for me. I like to use these serums while im young so i dont have these issues when im older. I definitely recommend in buying this product! 5/5 stars!

I have been using this for a number of months. It is mild and feels good going on. I keep using it because when I switched to a retinol based product, thinking it might be better, the retinol based product seemed to within a very short time, CREATE wrinkles, so I immediately switched back to this Vitamin C product which is richer and not harsh.
I used the entire product and I didn't see any changes in my dark circles. For the price, I won't buy again.
I have bought lots of products to help reduce my dark circles but this product is the best. It really works!!! Will definitely buy again if needed

I like to try different products and this is by far my favorite! I get dark circles from allergies or being on my computer to much. This gives me immediate results Ive never gone wrong with Murad product s

This stuff is amazing. I gave horrid dark circles and bags. I do get under eye fillers but that does nothing for the darkness. This stuff is a god send. However, it does get white and flakey so i just dont use it in the morning. I wear it over night and wash and tone my face in the morning. Its worth every penny

avis.titre: Does not work with my emu oil, smells like bacon
avis.texte: Works well, I have noticed a difference in the shade of purple under my eyes- they have lightened even within the first week of me using it. However, mine smells like bacon which is really odd to me. I also notice if I apply emu oil specifically (have not tried other oils so far), the serum lifts and rolls into little pills and I have to brush them off my face. It does not do this under my eye cream/moisturizer, just the days I layer with emu oil. I think in the future I would use this maybe during the more humid months, and find something that doesn't come off with the oil for dryer seasons where I need the extra moisture.

avis.titre: Only docking one star because of price
avis.texte: I ran out of this product about a month ago. I think it actually did help with my darker under eye circles a bit (mine aren't related to hyperpigmentation, rather, just being fair complected). I also have eczema and thought this product was moisturizing around the eyes. I recently purchased The Ordinary caffeine serum for my eyes, but that product does nothing for me unlike what the Murad serum has done for me. If anything, it dries my eyes out. The only problem with this product is the price. However, it lasted me about 6 months when I used it every day. Not bad

I have a habit of putting a lot of product on myself and when I did that with this product it looked like it dried up under my eyes. So now I put very little but it still does it. When I try to cover my under eyes with concealer, I can see the eye cream where it dried up. I don't have dry skin so I don't know why this is happening.
But you get such little product for the big price tag. I opened up the bottle think it's time to find a new product that won't rip you off.

I don't know why I didn't try this sooner. When I was in cosmetology school, this was the skin care brand they carried. I always loved the acne line, so I figured I would try out this eye serum. IT SERIOUSLY WORKS. I started using it around late April, and a few weeks ago I was doing my usual routine and noticed I looked so much more youthful. I'm 31, but let's face it, 3 years of living in the pandemic had me looking so stressed and older than how old I actually am. My under eyes are much brighter, and puffiness has definitely gone down. I seriously feel like I'm at least 26 again. I look rested instead of a haggard mess. I use both in the morning and at night. I would DEFINITELY RECOMMEND. I don't see myself using any other eye serum.

Not meant for black skin I apply this to my dark circles in my skin it turns it white it looks like as if I have foundation under my eyes! I'm not happy and the dark circles don't go away or the puffiness! Would not recommend it at all for dark skin women!
I'm glad this worked for some people. Did absolutely nothing for me. It's been 8 weeks.
Absolutely love this eye serum. Brightens and tightens my under eyes and concealer goes on nice too
Love the feel of it and n my skin, it's not too heavy & not too light. Love the coverage. Works great!

avis.titre: Made my regular skin care products pill
avis.texte: Background: I am 27, have a dry skin type, and have relentless dark circles from grad school. Based on the positive reviews, I really wanted to love this eye serum, but I don't. I have been using it for a month and do not notice any difference in my dark circles. Not only has it not helped the problem area it was intended for, it has also made my normal skin care products pill and it left a white residue under my eyes (I use tatcha dewy skin moisturizer and belif eye cream, which never pilled before incorporating this product). I hope this review helps others who might be in the same boat as me.

Used the entire bottle, it really didn't do anything to my dark circles. It does have tiny gold flakes in it which im sure helps with light reflection, but didn't correct anything. Super disappointed to have spent so much with no results. It does moisturize but i could've definitely bought something WAY cheaper to just moisturize my under eyes.
I used this product morning and night for 5 weeks. It ran out quickly, and it did absolutely nothing for my dark circles. It does NOT work and it's not worth the price.

I have used this product consistently every night for about a month now and this definitely helps with the dark circles. I have seen some puffiness go down but not significantly. It says to use AM and PM so I will definitely try to use both mornings and at night to see if anymore puffiness goes down. Definitely worth it for minimizing dark circles.

I read the reviews and was so excited to try this . I put it under my eyes and about 20 minutes later my eyes started to water because my eyes were stinging so bad. I had to rinse my eye area, but your eyes will stay irritated after that.
Based on the reviews I was really excited to try this. I used the whole bottle before writing this and can say I did not notice any different.

I really love this eye cream. It has truly helped lighten the dark circles under my eyes overtime. I thought the price was outrageous, but I've used a small amount once a day and it has lasted well over 5 months. A little sure goes a long way. I don't think I will be repurchasing because although I love this product, I don't see why I can't just tap my regular vitamin c serum under my eyes and then use my regular moisturizer over it. However, if you do prefer using an eye cream, I would recommend this one and suggest that you be patient with results. The skin under your eyes will thank you!

avis.titre: Does nothing more than my normal skin care routine
avis.texte: This was recommended by an Ulta rep in store for dark circles. I've not come across any product so far that really truly works. It has a hefty price tag, but with the assurance I could return it, I decided to give it a try. I've been using it for 2 weeks, every day, morning and night with my normal skin care routine (Kiehls, Evan Healy) and this.does.nothing. I had been using L'Oreal Eye brightener (imperial peony) which has rosy tones that offset the dark circles. It's around $11, and works better than the Murad, which is going back to the store in the morning.
What a great result. So good I purchased more after the sample.
This product illuminates your skin under your eyes while it's working. After two weeks my dark circles are so much better!

I'd been wanting to try this product but was hesitant since it was so expensive but I finally bit the bullet and bought it. I'm so annoyed I did, it did absolutely nothing for my undereyes. They actuality ended up looking worse cause I stopped using my regular Roc undereye cream to try this. Total waste of money. Started using Roc retinol correction eye cream again and my undereyes are slowly looking better.
Tap under eyes until evenly blended. Smooth and rich. Love the way it feels on my skin. A little bit goes a long way!

College-aged guy here with dark eye circles and infrequent puffiness. Despite good sleep habits and months of use, there seems to be little if any improvement for me. However, I only use it at night instead of the recommended AM/PM because it's so bright and I have no idea how to mask it.
I saw a slight difference in my lines/dark circles after using this for about a year. Other products have worked better for me. Not amazing for the price point.

I have tried EVERYthing for my dark circles,which I've had my whole life, and nothing has worked as well as this!! I use it morning and night, a little goes a long way. I noticed results within days. Dramatic results within two weeks. My dark circles have practically vanished! Seriously a wonder product.I am a loyal user for life!! Don't bother with any other eye products ,this one does what it promises!!
I have had dark eye circles since I was a child and after only a week of using this everyone around me has commented how much better my eyes look. Definitely woth the money!

avis.titre: This used to be a five star product, but they changed it
avis.texte: This was a repurchase for me. I was suspicious when the name was different, it was now "corrector" instead of "correcting serum" ( compare the picture vs the name of the item- as of this writing, they are different.) The new product is nowhere near as rich and creamy and no longer gives off that brightening yellow sheen which I loved. As for correcting dark circles, I don't know as I am returning this one.

I received this eye cream in a trial kit and then purchased the full size. I am 26, hispanic and work on a computer every day. I have used other eye creams in the past. This one appears to really be working for me after about 6 weeks using it both morning and night. My eyes look great in the morning, they are more youthful and my dark circles have lightened. I am very prone to acne so I was pleased that this did not irritate my skin at all. A little goes a long way with this cream. I am usually skeptical of products but I do not have any dislikes with this one.

avis.titre: I can't stop looking in the mirror!
avis.texte: So I've had bags and dark circles for as long as i could remember I honestly thought I'd have them forever but I tried this product and not to sound corny but i literally can not believe my eyes. I started noticing a difference after just a few days of using it. My eyes looks so awake and vibrant and they are actually well on there way to becoming to same color as the rest of my face. I highly recommend this serum it's definitely given me a huge boost in my confidence

I went into Ulta looking for under eye color corrector and the sales woman recommend this to me. I balked a bit at the price but she swore it was liquid gold, and I'm a sucker so I bought it without even googling it (gasp!). After ONE USE I was hooked. INSTANTLY brightens the eye, and I've been using a week so I'm excited to see the long term effects as well!

After about two weeks of consistent use (every evening before bed), I seriously noticed a decrease in the darkness of my under eye circles! It is expensive, but since I use it all the time and it works for me, I say it's totally worth it. The other day I was in Ulta, possibly looking for a concealer, and the salesperson asked if I was currently wearing any makeup, but I wasn't; she couldn't believe it! I don't even feel the need to wear an undereye concealer anymore!! Personally, I prefer a more natural look, as opposed to the super bright and highlighted look that some people like. So for those who want that look, you might still want to wear concealer, but I know I am finally comfortable without one. That's how good this product is!

I'm mid 40s with dark circles and puffiness under my eyes and can attest to this product working well! On a scale of 1-10 with darkest being 10 my circles were a 5-6. I don't get quality sleep and have been looking for a product to help reduce dark circles and minimize puffiness. I noticed a difference in just 2 days using AM and PM. I love the gold, orange hue it has to immediately reduce dark circles and my puffiness has reduce 90%. I've been using the product for a month now and love it and whole heartedly recommend it for dark circles and puffiness.

I've applied this product daily for 2 weeks but have not noticed any significant change in my dark spots or blemishes, nor has the skin gotten any lighter. The serum is clear and applies smoothly. I do notice the scent of Vitamin C when dispensed and applied on the skin. It may be because of the properties of Vitamin C, but it did leave my skin feeling a little tacky and tight and I wanted to apply moisturizer over it.

I noticed that the Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector has gold accents in it as a number of under eye gel's collagen eye mask do, to reduce eye bags and wrinkles. The Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector is very hydrating around the delicate part of my eyes. Today, I received a little bit of burning during the initial application but, after that it subsided. After 10 days of use, my skin feels like it's tightening. Thank you BzzAgent Team for the opportunity to try the Murad products.

I'm in the middle of a 2 week trial period for this product and I haven't seen much improvement in terms of correcting my dark circles. It was recommended that I use the product for two weeks in order to see results and I'll be back with a review update at that time. I received this complimentary product from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest opinion.

I'm a single mom to 4 kids, all of whom are homeschooling full time right now. Between homeschooling them all and being stuck inside, stress is super high and sleep is... well it's not! I've developed dark circles under my eyes from lack of restful sleep and stress. I could see a difference with this in just a couple of days. My dark circles were brightened and I looked rested and refreshed. Even my 11 year old noticed and made a comment! He said "wow, you look like you slept for hours!" I didn't, but this certainly helps me look like I did!

When I use this cream it makes the skin under my eyes look and feel so soft. I have sensitive skin and I have not had any allergic reaction which is a plus for me. This has been my new fav in my skincare routine!

This has an immediate brightening around your eyes-dramatically so! It gives your under eyes an almost sparkly brightened look, but use it sparingly! I got a little heavy handed one night & found it would pill & looked almost like a highlighter under my eyes. If used lightly it wakes your under eyes & orbital region up—to the point that I didn't need concealer under my eyes. Since there is a temporary effect, it can be used both night & day to brighten your eyes. After a few weeks it is supposed to have permanent brightening effects w/ its Niacinamide & gold stabilized Vit C. It's definitely focused on brightening opposed to being a moisturizer heavy eye cream but still provides the level I need personally. Although none of it outweighs the positive, there are a few things I disliked about the eye cream. First, it does have a slight tingle/burn when first applied to the thin & fragile skin directly around my eyes. It does go away quickly but it was a concern at first. I'm dismayed by the inclusion of Dimethicone (silicone) in it. It allows for it to smooth over your skin & create this protected & smoothed feeling but there is so much varying info about its safety in cosmetics. Finally, I disliked the packaging. It is deceptive in how much is in the bottle—it is twice the size of how much is actually in it (has 15mL inside), but it is the fact that you are unable to see how much is left in the container. It doesn't appear you can open it up unless you destroy the bottle & you

This is a hydrating eye cream that is soothing and helps calm the eye area as well as help with dark circles. It's pretty comparable to my Sunday Riley Auto Correct, but since this formula doesn't have caffeine, you don't get the tingling that you do with the Auto Correct. I will say if you have puffiness, it doesn't seem to do too much, but I haven't used this longer than a month so I can't say for sure it lightens the dark circles a ton.
I didn't see too much change in my under eye area. I was disappointed because I really thought it would work. I do like how it adds shimmer though.
I have deep bags under my eyes and noticed quick results in the reduction of my under eye bags and also on my sun spots throughout my mask line.

Dark eye circles is not a huge issue for my at the moment, but I am always one for being proactive in managing my skin. This product was easy to dispense and apply. It did not feel too heavy or greasy. I liked using this especially on days when I wore make-up (I try to at least go make-up free on the weekends) as it helped balance the coloring of the darker areas I do have.

I received the Murad Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector for my honest review. I have used this product for about two weeks and think it works okay. The serum is light, with gold flecks in it. It has definitely brightened around my eyes. I still have dark circles, but I'm not sure any product can fix them. I am happy with the results though and will continue to use this product.

As someone who has suffered from dark circles under my eyes since I was in middle school, I never really thought there would be anthing that would be able to help the problem. However, I can honestly say I have nticed a visible difference since I started using this product. Overall it is a good formula. It's not some kind of miracle potion that will make the dark circles go away over night but I can say from personal experience that with consistent and continual use, this product has slowly shown results for me.

I got this free for review purposes from BzzAgent. The main and only active ingredient is Vitamin C, which is a good antioxidant (can prevent and reverse signs of aging) and can lighten dark skin discolorations over time. The main moisturizing ingredients are glycerin and silicone, and it has some slightly shiny mineral pigment to reflect light and somewhat offset dark circles and shadows. The formulation is pretty standard. The Vitamin C can lighten dark circles caused the skin around the eye actually being darker, but mine are due to being pale and being able to see the blood vessels through my skin, so. Lol. Also, caffeine, which has been the only thing that really minimizes my type of dark circles, isn't included. It can also help reduce swelling/puffiness, which this product claims it can do with an algae extract. I have noticed perhaps a slight de-puffing effect, but I'm honestly not really sure. Basically, it's a decent price but the price is outrageous. You can get moisturizing products with Vitamin C for a lot cheaper. This just isn't offering anything extraordinary for the price - no peptides or other newer, exciting ingredients, not even caffeine. I expect more from a high end brand like Murad. The bottle is cute though.

I am in love with this eye serum. It's very light and absorbs very quickly into my skin with zero eye/skin irritation. I really like the microminerals to give a little brightening right away. My eyes appear a lot less tired! One thing to be careful of - a little goes a long way. A full pump is way too much, use about half a pump.

I've got Scandinavian in my genetics and the hereditary dark circles under eyes that comes with it. Doesn't matter how much sleep I get or don't get. They are always there. Nothing has ever worked before. Concealer is a must have for me - even on no makeup days. This really did help. They key for me was to use 2xs a day - before makeup and at night. I think it's because the gold infused cream reflects light rather than absorbs it. Genius! And other ingredients help strengthen your delicate thin under eye skin which helps too. Only a very small amount is needed. A full pump was too much so this will last and last. The price tag 🏷 is more than worth it.

Murad is a very good product for me. I liked the serum for the spots. If it is lightening the spots and I think it is the freckles. What I like the most is that it has no perfume. I do not support products with perfume

I need more time it sort of clogged the pores a bit and peeled the skin a bit. I saw a little improvement but not as much as I wanted. I was given this product for free to test for my unbiased opinion.

I do really enjoy this product but I didn't find the results great. I was hoping for a bit more correction BUT I do thoroughly enjoy the product, the fact that it goes on smoothly, and that a little guys a long way. Definitely a worthwhile product!

I'm always skeptical when trying a new skin product but this did not disappoint and will be in my regular routine from now on. My face really does look brighter and more youthful. I'm excited to see what continued use brings about. I also want to point out how nice the packaging is, I love the bottle style it doesn't pump out too much product resulting in waste.

I'm so happy to have been able to try this product as I love this brand! To start off I will say I do not think eye creams are necessary but Iam seeing results with this particular product. I do not have a issue with dark under eyes ..more so puffiness. I do find that this helps calm that area down. The biggest difference I notice is my under eye area seems much brighter already! I love that is does not burn my eyes as that seems to a issue I have had in the past.

I can't give the best review of this product because I don't have dark under eye circles, but I did like the packaging, consistency of the product, and it had a neutral smell. Also, it didn't irritate my skin, so that's a plus. I'd recommend it to someone that actually needs it.

This under cream is the best. It is not messy and it sits well. It really hydrates and it has gotten rid of the fine lines around my eyes. I would recommend this to everyone. Lots of creams don't work and are messy. This one is very absorbing and the small shine gives your eyes the extra boost they need to look less tired.

I've been using this for a few days now and I do see a little difference but not much. I do have dark circles so maybe with continued use I will see more of a difference. I got this complimentary from BzzAgent in exchange for a review.
I've been using this product for about 2 weeks. I seen my dark circles are lighter. loved it!

i am loving this brand so far, heard nothing but good things and i was happy to have received this product to review! i have been using the vita-c eyes dark circle corrector for about 2 weeks now and I am seeing major improvements. my fine lines are waaayyy less visible and under eye brighter! the product seem to have some shimmer to it thou so maybe that helps the brighten effect. anyhow, i am happy with the results and will continue to use it! i recommend you give it a try!

I have to rave about this product. I rarely ever leave reviews, and yes, I did receive this product as a part of a promotion, but that does not in any way affect my review. Now that's out of the way, I have sensitive, pale, combination skin with under-eye circles that are reminiscent of an anorexic raccoon with a sleep disorder. I have tried so many different products from drugstore brands to ~ordinary~ brands, to even ~bananas~ with expensive cult-classic products from high-end Danish brands. My first impression of this product, which I used in conjunction with the Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum, was very positive. The texture was creamy though still light, unlike some grittier under-eye products, and the scent was minimal but pleasant. I didn't feel any initial painful sting as I have with other products fueled by Vitamin C. The weeks following proved that this product is the one to buy. Honestly, just stop what you're doing with reading all of the reviews and just purchase this one. It's THE one. My eye circles diminished so much I looked like I did in the days before I had discovered this product after habitually tapping on a gallon of undereye concealer until I had symptoms of carpal tunnel. I will be using this product until it's completely panned and will be sure to purchase it again and again. Thank you soooo much Murad, after two weeks of using this product religiously, I now look like I actually get healthy amounts of sleep and hydrate regularly.
Was recommended to me by my sister and it is without a doubt worth it. I highly recommend getting it.

avis.titre: Helps with every day, not a cure for chronic allergy eyes
avis.texte: I have allergic shiners, so I know that nothing will ever cure my lifelong dark circles. However, in the nee covid world and working in healthcare, they're gotten worse. This has helped bring me back to my baseline. And, for the first time, I can finally get a concealer to work at covering them. I'm thrilled!!!

The environment and environmental exposure cause so much damage. I like the dark circle corrector gives me confidence that I am counteracting the negative effects and helping my skin (especially under my eyes) with vitamin C a well know antioxidant. I like how smooth it is and that it isn't creamy or sticky.

I have a dark circles all my life. I am 36 now and tried a lot of different products. Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum & Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector is really working. I use it for a 2 weeks now AM and PM and I see the difference. Dark circles are still there, but the eye area skin is brighter. I am really hope it will became better within time. I am planning to use it constantly. Small dark spots under the right eye almost gone. You can see one on the picture but it is still a great result for me. Thank you Dr.Murad. I received a product as a gift in exchange of my honest opinion.

I apply a small amount in my eye area after cleansing in the morning and at night. The cream goes on smooth and it doesn't get sticky or flake off. I also like to apply a serum and moisturizer over the corrector. I've notice a slight change in my eye area it looks much brighter. My dark circles under my eyes are not as noticeable as before. This is a great under eye product!
This product is awesome. Feels so fresh after a nice shower and was a great addition to my skin care routine.

This eye product is nice and light, feels good on. The dark circle brightening is nice, I wish this product also had ingredients to fight wrinkles. The packaging is awful, just layers of un-recyclable plastic. I wish this was in a glass, seems more appropriate for this brand.

avis.titre: It makes my dark circles lighter
avis.texte: Have been using it for almost a week am and pm. I can see my dark circles has lighten up a bit, no irritation or burn feeling like other eyecream I use, so far I like it a little drop goes a long way

I've been using this for 2 weeks now and it works really well! My dark circles aren't completely gone, but they are reduced considerably. I will say that the pump isn't great to use, however, but the product itself is solid.

I am so happy with the results from using this dark circle corrector. The lotion color is actually pretty (light orange with gold specks). Virtually no smell. One pump does put out way more than is needed and once it's dry does have a tendency to flake if you use to much. I literally had instant results. After I gently patted the lotion in under my eyes, I could actually see the dark purple/blue color disappear! As long as I didn't rub my eyes the results lasted almost all day. My undereye makeup didn't crease or appear dry. It looked like I got a full 8 hours sleep. I received alot of compliments that I looked well rested.

I was so excited to get this dark circle corrector, and I feel like a brand new person. Using this every day has really changed the way my skin looks and I'm very happy to be able to use it more in the future.
I had a different brand before trying this, & got discouraged because I didn't really think it worked. This worked so much better. I was extremely pleasantly surprised!

This may just be my favorite new product!! I was pleasantly surprised by how well this product works for dark circles! I have very dry skin and was told by my esthetician to use Vitamin C for texture improvement. When I put this product on it feels so lightweight and makes my skin feel silky smooth! It makes your skin glowy around your eyes which I love! I feel like a little goes a long way. Will definitely be getting another bottle. Top notch quality!

got this as a sample to try out and ive been using it for a few weeks now and i have actually seen a nice improvement of the darkness of my under eyes. its really gentle on the skin and no irritation at all. so far im loving it, murad is one of my favorite brands so im not surprised that i like another of their products
This is hands down an excellent choice for under eye treatment.

I have some light dark circles under my eye and this stuff really helped! My eyes are brighter and the dark circles are so much lighter. I like to use this am and pm! It is a light texture so doesnt feel too heavy under the eye area for the day time especially.

First off, this is a review of the spot corrector serum, because I accidentally wrote the review for this product over there. Now, I received a free sample of this in exchange for my honest review. Anyway, so again, psyched to try this because I love Murad! I think I noticed more of a difference in regards to results with this vs eye product. I have some freckles/age spots, and I did notice a difference in their appearance, and my skins overall appearance. It looked less red, and more evenly toned and bright. Overall, this one is a win for me!

avis.titre: Best Eye Cream for Dark Circles
avis.texte: I have been struggling for years to fade or get rid of my dark circles but had no luck until I tried this Murad eye cream. The dark circles under my eyes are diminishing and I am so happy.

I really enjoy this product! It's very hydrating, no fragrance that I could notice, and absorbs nicely into my under eyes, leaving them feeling very plump and happy. This will brighten your under eye area, mainly because of the pigment/micro shimmer sort of additive this product has. I personally don't mind, but it's good to know. I had no issues with irritation to my eyes or the surrounding skin. I would definitely recommend this product.
I've tried a bunch of different products and none of them come even close to Murad ..so far so good

avis.titre: My dark under eye circles are GONE!!!
avis.texte: I thought I was never going to be able to get rid of them and this serum has made that possible! I love it!!
First of all, my dark circles isn't to mach dark. Honestly I didn't see differences before and after using. But I love the gentle texture with little sparkles.

The Environmental shield is a great eye cream as it leaves a light and non-greasy feeling on your skin. I don't like eye creams that feel heavy, which this product does not do. The cream also does not have a smell and leaves my skin feeling very hydrated. As for the dark circle corrector I have noticed minor changes after using it for 1 week, so I am hoping to seem more results over time.

I love using Murad's Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector! It absorbs quickly and instantly makes my eyes look better. No sensitivity and it works well under makeup. I've been having some serious sleep issues and this has been making me look like I got a full 8 hours!

Now anyone who knows me knows I love vitamin C inside and out! So I was excited to try Murad's Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector. Although I don't really suffer from dark circles and I don't know if it helps with that. I will say it did brighten up my eye area which is great because that's where it mostly shows when I'm tired. Better and Brighter! Always Shine!
I love their Vita-C line! I have had a huge difference in my acne scars, my tone, and even helping with texture. They feel amazing on my skin and I wi Definitely be stocking up on the whole line.

I have only been able to use this product a handful of times since receiving 2 weeks ago, but impressed thus far. As a man I do not use a ton of products, however dark circles and bags around my eyes are one of my main cosmetic concerns. Murad Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum & Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector seem to be working effectively! I will continue to use and am grateful for the opportunity to review.

I was really excited about this and am grateful to have received it complimentary for reviewing purposes. I have some older acne scars and dark spots that I've been trying to get rid of and while I didn't see an enormous or immediate difference, I did notice a slight difference. After using it for 2 weeks I've found it's helped brighten my skin and lightly lifted dark spots on my cheeks and forehead. It smells nice and absorbs quickly leaving behind a slightly sticky feeling but that fades after applying moisturizer. I will continue to use it and monitor progress but so far I really like it!

avis.titre: This is the eye cream I've needed!
avis.texte: I have had chronicle dark circles my whole life and recently I've started seeing that my fine lines stay after I've finished smiling. I've only been using this product for 2 weeks but I love the pearlescent, color correcting tone that instantly brightens the area. I also love that it doesn't pill under makeup. I'll need to keep using it to see longer term effects but so far I love it!

I have hereditary very dark circles under my eyes. I don't know if long term this would ever eliminate them but it definitely lightens them. If you have minimal dark circles this would be amazing. I love it though bc it instantly lightens my under eye area. The serum comes out gold and does have a shimmer but I've never seen actual glitter on my eyes. I've attached a photo so you can see I have nothing on my face except the serum under one eye and you can see it's lighter just from the serum. Sinks into the skin nicely and doesn't affect my makeup application. I love it.

avis.titre: The difference is Night and Day
avis.texte: I've been increasingly more comfortable wearing less makeup due to working at home. My main concern now is the circles around my eyes. Due to aging, the puffy bags are now dark and sunken circles. This corrector has helped me reverse the process by lightening the circles and making my entire face look bright and more lively. The product is lightweight and not greasy, and does not leave a residue on my pillow or sheets in the morning. It is not an immovable part of my skincare routine and I'd highly recommend it.

I was impressed by the Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector. It has a nice, light feel and absorbs quickly. My favorite feature was one which came as a surprise; this serum conceals! This is accomplished by way of camouflaging qualities that leave a reflective sparkle, giving the illusion of less (or no) dark circles. This ingenious feature is one which has been lacking in the under-eye serums and creams on the market, although in hindsight it seems so obvious - like moisturizers being moisturizing. This has come to required in my under-eye serum! Meanwhile, this product successfully fulfills its mission by improving the appearance of dark circles under your eyes - and it firms and moisturizes as well. Some may ask why, if giving such a glowing review, did I rate this under-eye serum with 4 stars, not 5... The reason is that I am of the opinion that there is ALWAYS room for improvement, so I almost never give 5 star ratings. I believe a 5 star rating should be reserved for items that are perfect, that would not benefit from additions or changes of any sort.
I have been using this product for one week and couldn't tell a difference at all. Thank goodness I took a before pic and current pic to compare. Check out the difference!

I had the privilege of trying Murad's Rapid Dark Spot Correcting Serum & Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector. While I don't think I have tried these products long enough to see their full effect on my coloring, I can certainly see the beginnings of color correcting. Regardless, these products have left my face and eye area soft and hydrated.
I definitely felt like it worked really good. My husband used it as well and he saw a big difference in his eye bags

After using this product for two weeks, I have noticed a slight lessening in the visibility of the dark circles under my eyes. It's not dramatic, but there has been a difference in that I don't notice them quite as much. If you have dark circles under your eyes, I'd recommend this but wouldn't expect those dark circles to completely disappear.

I like the product as a dark circle corrector and it helped with dark eyelids, too. It goes on smooth with light tapping and it isn't smelly or greasy. It's also cruelty free which is important to me. I don't have much hyperpigmentation around my eyes but I do get dark circles and redness occasionally. This cream helped minimize the appearance of those issues. However, because it is a gold cream, it looks like a gold luminescent highlighter. If you're using more face products afterwards (like moisturizer and sunscreen as suggested) it's fine but I still had a little gold show through those items. I don't wear full makeup often so I don't want to add it if I don't have to. I'm okay with a little highlight effect but I do think it's worth noting. I'll recommend for gentle cream and effectiveness but just know about the gold tone that can show up easily.

The stress and strain over the last many months has only deepened the bluish circles under my eyes. I've been looking for a product that could alleviate this problem so I was happy that BzzAgent included me in a trial of Murad's Vita- C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector. I've been trying this product for about two weeks in the hope that I could eventually discard my concealer. Unfortunately, at this time I've been unable to do so. While the bluish circles have faded some, in the corners under my eyes nearest my nose, the circles are still pretty visible. Perhaps over time I'll see more improvement. I'm not yet ready to give up on this product! For now, at least, I will hold off recommending it.
The serum has smooth textures, spreads and absorbs easily. It reduces my dark circles visibly. Also helps with puffiness and tired looking eyes. Would recommend, great product

I used this product as recommended, twice a day. After nearly two weeks of use, I have to say that I have seen brightening in my skin and I am pleasantly surprised with how this is working on my skin! It is a lightweight formula that doesn't feel heavy on my skin, nor does it leave me feeling oily. You can wear it alone or under makeup. A full pump of this product is too much in my opinion though, I just use about half a pump for both eyes. It has a slight shimmer to it so I don't want to be too heavy-handed when applying. However, I would definitely recommend this product! I received this product free, but all opinions are my own.

I really like the gold color on this dark circle corrector. It really helped brighten the eye area while also fading the dark circles. With COVID messing up my sleep pattern, I have really needed something new to try. I would definitely purchase this in the future!

I have been using Murad Vita-C Eyes Dark Circle Corrector for a week diligently now and I am starting to see results. The darkness beneath my eyes appears somewhat reduced. I believe it will take more time for solid results, but it really does brighten the appearance and leave skin feeling refreshed. I have pale skin and fairly deep dark circles. I have used MANY different products. This appears to make a difference where others have failed anything more than temporarily. The gold shimmer in this formula reflects the light and appears to make the circles look less severe. It is important to not use too much at a time, so it doesn't clump up or pill. Patting it in gently until absorbed was my best bet for application. Make sure to allow plenty of time to absorb and don't immediately stack other product on top, for best results. I am currently applying twice daily. I look forward to seeing further results with time.
I haven't been able to find an eye cream that works for me let alone that I see results with. Using this day and night has proved such an improvement and I won't stop using this eye cream.
